description: Records that a move has shipped: today's date and, optionally, the URL of the new page. From the next morning's check, briefing and trend show what changed since. Not destructive; undo with undo: true. The only tool that writes. Use it after the person (or their coding session) has shipped the move.

site.description: Which of your sites: its domain ("biotree.bio"), its id from list_my_sites ("biotree-bio") or its name. Leave it out when the person has one site.

undo.description: true to take back a mark made by mistake.

url.description: The shipped page's URL, if there is one.

name: mark_move_done

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the person.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" for a question back, a plain no, or nothing there yet (see message).

title: I've shipped it
